reviews.text: Our dog goes to daycare here once a week and it's her favourite place to be, she rockets out of bed when we say "daycare day" and jumps all over the team when they greet her at drop off. They also post cute pics of the dogs daily... which is always fun to see!  Highly recommend!

Grateful for the care the staff at Noelle’s Pet Love have shown my Newfoundland. She gets so excited when she sees their team each day, especially Dennis. Even after trying other dog walking services, my dog seems most comfortable and happy with this team.

I could not recommend them more! I was a very nervous puppy mom. And I work in the office a lot. And I was worried I couldn’t handle having a puppy on my own. The team at Noelle’s made it possible!

They are so informative, caring, supportive and compassionate.

Besides daycare, I also did puppy training classes on Sundays. And hired Sandy for one-on-one training. I’m beyond happy with all their services. It made the whole experience more pleasant.

My dog is always so excited to be there. Thanks, Noelle’s team 🫶🏻
This is a great place. My dog loves going to Noelle's, staff is very attentive and responsive and they will make sure your dog is well taken care of. Thank you Vincent, Noelle and other staff!

Our Toller, Nova, has been going to Noelle's for a few months and we've loved it so far! The team is super friendly, and we love that Nova gets to go on beach walks. It's always fun to see the video Noelle shares from the adventures!
Bean has been coming here for about a month and we’ve already seen a positive change - she’s more social and confident with other dogs. The staff are caring and attentive.

As a first-time dog mum, I was quite nervous about daycare. I could see the benefits, but like many people, you tend to hear more about the negatives, and that made me hesitant to leave my puppy. Penny is definitely a “Velcro dog,” and we spend a lot of time together, so it wasn’t an easy step for me.
That said, it only took a few visits before everything changed. Now, after our morning walk around Noelle’s, she actually picks up speed a block away, tail wagging, and sits at the gate whining with excitement. When Vincent comes down the stairs, she is absolutely thrilled to see him! We’re still working on calm greetings (which Vincent handles very graciously despite Penny’s enthusiasm), but it’s clear how much she loves being there. Even this morning, the same excitement for Dennis, tail wagging the whole time.
The team is always incredibly friendly and has been so patient with all my questions, concerns, and requests for updates. I really appreciate the time they’ve taken to support me as I learn to be okay spending time away from Penny, knowing she’s happy and well cared for.
We’ve even bumped into some of her daycare friends at Pacific Spirit Park, those funny moments when the humans realize why the dogs are so excited to see each other!
Noelle’s Pet Love has been such a wonderful addition to our “doggy team.” Thank you for taking such great care of Penny!

We couldn’t be happier with our experience at Noelle’s!

Our rescue Squish, has been going there for the past year, and it has truly been the best decision we’ve made for him.

From the moment he arrives, it’s clear how much he loves it, his excitement says everything. Noelle and Vincent are incredible! And a huge shout out to Dennis (sp), Squish absolutely loves him!

They genuinely care about every dog and create such a positive, structured, and loving environment.

What really sets Noelle’s apart is that it’s a training focused daycare. Squish isn’t just burning energy, he’s learning, growing, and building great habits.

His daily beach walks are a highlight (for him and for us watching the videos) and we love knowing he’s getting both mental and physical enrichment.

One of the biggest signs of how comfortable he is there is that he actually rests when he needs to. That level of trust and security in a daycare environment is huge. Of course, he also has plenty of play time and has made so many dog friends! it’s the perfect balance.

As someone who has worked with dogs for years and has a background in training, I can confidently say this is the best daycare in Vancouver. The knowledge, care, and attention they provide are unmatched.

We haven’t had the chance to use their boarding services yet, but we absolutely will as soon as we have an opportunity to travel. We wouldn’t hesitate for a second to recommend Noelle’s!

Thank you, Noelle’s, for taking such amazing care of Squish!

Noelle's Pet Love has been a lifesaver for me.  They have longer hours than most which is very convenient.  Plus, how excited my dog gets to go there every single time speaks for itself.  Would highly recommend!
My puppy Barney loves Noelle Pet Love. He comes home tired and happy. We took the puppy trainings classes with Sandy which were excellent.

Our corgi has been going to Noelle’s for daycare since he was only a few months old! He’s now 1 and has always been a confident pup but still continues to be excited during drop off, spending time with his furry friends and staff. It really gets his energy out, with the daily group walks and training sessions. It’s also lovely to see that staff seem to know each dog by name. The updates of how the day went by one of the staff, Dennis, is always appreciated during pick up. The hours are also great where it’s not a huge rush during rush hour to get from work to the daycare and vice versa. The only thing I’d suggest is to also be able to manually make changes/requests to a package schedule directly on paw partner. Reaching out is fine but a nice add to be able to do. Overall great experience
Wonderful people to deal with and a great place for our dog to spend his time for daycare
My dog archie loves his time with Noelle' Daycare --- we go every few days and it's the higlight of his week.

Chili goes here once a week and for occasional boarding. Noelle’s is wonderful. The dogs are well looked after and my Chili enjoys her runs at the beach. There is nothing but praise from me for Noelle’s. A joy to have this facility.

I just had the pleasure of having my dog groomed here by Nina. Nina was just wonderful. She groomed my dog amazingly well—my dog looks like a show dog!  I am so very, very pleased with this added service of Noelle’s. This place is the absolute best
Noelle and her team are amazing! Our 5 year old active Husky has been going since she was a young puppy and loves her time at Noelle’s Pet Love.

Our Boxer loves going in for his daycare days at Noelle’s. They were great about on-boarding him and making sure it was a good fit before we committed. And we have received good updates on how he did that day at pickup. The video updates on days he went to the beach walk were also a nice touch and it was good to see him having fun. Sadly we are moving across town so the location doesn’t work for us but otherwise he would still be going.
Thank you!

We are so glad we found Noelle's. The team there are an exception bunch, who have taken great care of our miniature poodle Levi since he was a puppy - daycare, doggy training, and lots of great walks. Levi arrives with a wagging tail each time we drop him off. We know he's in good hands and really appreciate everything they do!

Best doggy daycare! Our dog is always super excited to go and when we pick her up she looks happily exhausted and sleeps through the entire evening. Also loves the account of events of the day from Kyra and Sunny during the pickup as well as the beach walk videos!
Our dog Josie has thoroughly enjoyed going to Noelle’s - we would recommend it for anyone looking for a doggy daycare! The staff were always friendly and accommodating.

We’ve been sending our dog Otis to daycare here for over three years, since he was a tiny puppy, and we truly can’t imagine a better place for him. The staff are incredible. They know every dog and their personality, and it shows in the way they interact with each one individually. We always feel like Otis is not just safe and well cared for, but genuinely loved.

We chose this daycare for the structured beach walks, and the high standards of care, and it has exceeded our expectations. Otis has great recall thanks to everything he’s learned there, and he always comes home happy, tired, and mentally stimulated.

We get regular updates about his day, which always makes us smile. The staff greet him with such warmth every morning, and he returns the love with full-body butt waggles and a helicopter tail. It’s clear he’s just as excited to be there as we are to have found this team.

Otis is there nearly every day, and we feel incredibly lucky to be part of this community and grateful for the wonderful humans who make it so special.
We have used Noelle’s for both doggy daycare and boarding while we are out of town. Can’t say enough positive things about our experience with them. Highly recommend!

We have been using Noelles daycare for over 2.5years for our Dog Ollie.
They have been flexible with switching dates and adding dates. We have also had Ollie board overnight and like that they do not lock the dogs in a kennel at the House. It is great that they take the dogs on a daily off leash walk at the beach on all daycare days. Great training tips too.Thanks! 🐕 WOOF WOOF.

I have been taking Daisy to Noelle’s for almost 2 years now. She loves it, the staff are super friendly and great with the dogs. Would definitely recommend. This is how she spends the rest of the day after I pick her up :)

I have been sending my little man Finnegan to Noelle’s Pet love for the last two years. I had to source a new daycare after an incident at his previous daycare. Lucky for us, Noelle and the team welcomed Finn and his lust for living. Or better stated “FOMO”. He learned the basics of how to get along in the world and has evolved into a wonderful pupper, in large part to his time at NPL. This past January, my little man suffered a bad back injury and needed a calmer environment. Fortunately again, they accommodated his needs and he is back to his usual exuberant self! I highly recommend NPL for thoughtful, consistent care for our beloved pups🐶❣️
Lori & Finnegan

My sausage dog Patty LOVES Noelle’s Day Care. She has been happily going for three years and always receives the love and attention she has become accustomed to. The staff are friendly and knowledgeable and each take pains to learn the quirks of every dog in their care. Patty is always thrilled to see Vincent, and to be carried like the queen she is down the stairs by Syd.

My lagotto Aza is so happy on her days with Noelle and her experienced crew. It’s clear they all love dogs and what they are doing. And my dog loves them.
We were also very fortunate to have had Aza spend 3 weeks over Christmas with Noelle and her family and got daily updates of Aza playing on the beach and walking in the forest.
Aza loves the dog interaction and her behavior with other dogs is much better since she started attending regular day boarding.
Thank-you Noelle and your team!!

This is a review of their poor communications. I've been wanting to try their dog walking services for a while and was told my dog must attend their daycare a few times to be assessed for suitability. That's fine with me, except their schedule was incredibly difficult to accommodate, as they only had 1 person who was only available during weekdays®ular work hours. After many back and forth emails with Noelle, we finally managed to book a time on a Monday at 3pm to meet with Vincent at the daycare. But when we arrived, we were told Vincent was off on that day. No previous communication/apology whatsoever on the missed appointment. They also don't answer their phones, so the only way to communicate was through emails with Noelle, who seemed too busy to reply to clients inquiry on a timely manner. I cannot comment on their daycare quality, etc., but the poor communications were enough to turn me away.
Amazing staff! My dog Rio absolutely loves spending the day there. He gets so excited to go and always comes home happy and tired. I 100% recommend them!

Our dog Chili has been regularly attending Noelle's daycare for nearly 2.5 years now, which we are so grateful for since he is a rescue and required lots of training and socialization. With Noelle's daycare he has improved dramatically in his reactivity behavior and is now more confident interacting with other dogs. We always trust Noelle and her team to take great care of our dog who loves being there and hanging with her dad and his other dog pals!
Noelle's took such amazing care of our little Diego. We're not based in Vancouver right now but will definitely bring him back when we return!
This spot did a great job!

Noelle’s has been a great place for Maggie. The team looking after the dogs are kind and patient. My dog is a bit anxious but is always happy and tired when I pick her up. She loves the beach walk and I know she’s well cared for.  I’m also new to Vancouver and the team at Noelle’s have been helpful to both me and Maggie which has helped with our transition. Totally recommend this daycare!
Thank you!

My puppy has separation anxiety and these guys are amazing in their job. They understand all his needs and emotions even though he’s shy. He loves going to daycare now and playing with his friends! And I am beyond grateful for finding Noelle’s and this professional team after a previous bad experience.

I can’t say enough about Noelle’s - my puppy Wilbur has been going to daycare here 1x/week since he was only a few months old. It’s been really great for his socialization, especially learning body language and building confidence (they were the ones to finally get him to try going up/down the stairs!). I’ve never seen him as excited as he is when he sees us pull into the parking lot, it’s really clear that he loves his weekly visits.

Since he started joining the weekly beach walks I’ve noticed a huge improvement in his recall and focus while off leash. This is an area I was struggling with and I really appreciated the extra help!

Wilbur and I would 100% recommend!

My dogs LOVE Noelle's (as much as they love Playful Pups in Richmond) and I love everyone at Noelle's too- everyone is so kind, warm, and super hardworking!

Before finding out about them, I'd met the dogwalkers on Spanish Banks several times and they're all diligent and gentle, and the dogs are always super happy and friendly, which is why I decided to try them out for my dogs.

It's a true family business and I can't thank them enough for being so supportive of me as a dog-parent, and of my dogs ❤️

My dog definitely is difficult to groom so was looking for a groomer who is patient, calm and able to deal with him so he would have a good experience that would relieve his anxiety and stress and Naoko was exceptional! Highly recommend.

Please read warning. I have no trust in Noelle nor this business after they edited their original reply.
--
My original Review: Although the Daycare is quite good due to the team, especially Vincent, we discontinued all services because the owner is rude and unreceptive to feedback.

I would not recommend boarding for an active dog.
--
Edit:
I noticed that Noelle had her Management team edit her highly unprofessional reply to my review, so I now feel that I must expand my review in order to warn others.

After our puppy had a good time at daycare, we inquired about boarding and were told that they stay with Noelle at her home. We were surprised to discover that her father was overseeing her, and he gave us feedback that our active 8mth puppy was constantly whining to go outside and pooped in the house. As we knew nothing of her father's qualifications, and felt that the boarding service may not have been suitable for an active dog, or that she wasn't given enough outdoor time to play, we sent an e-mail to voice our experience.

Rather than reassuring us of the service, Noelle sent back an extremely long e-mail saying that we were criticizing her and her father. She was extremely rude and defensive. All her e-mails are written as one big aggressive paragraph with caps lock here and there. It's quite immature really.  (see un-edited replies to reviews for yourself).

Her father's bio was not up on the website as she claimed, and has since added it, although it was clear that the boarding did not have a Vet Tech nor staff from the Daycare supporting with care—regardless of what they say.

Our intention was to provide critical feedback so she could improve her business, so I'm glad she has changed her policies around boarding. This proves that some mistakes were made, despite her lack of willingness to show any accountability.

The fact that she replied the way she did, edited her website, and edited her original reply to this review shows how unstable and reactive Noelle is. I would not trust my dog with her for an instant at this point.

As for their professionally edited but misleading reply:
- Their boarding staff is her elderly father, and only him. They are not looked after by a vet tech.
- Her father does not work at the daycare. If Noelle or her staff help out, it's not always the case. Her father has no credentials besides that "he loves the dogs"
- We paid for all services, and given that our Puppy only had 2 visits to daycare and 1 boarding visit, their claim to not charge for 5 days of daycare and boarding is a blatant lie.

--

In reply to the edit of their edit...

re. payment, I wouldn't call cancellations per contract some kind of courtesy when the messaging is "I accept your cancellation and appreciate that you are aware as per the contract of the cancellation policy but you do not need to bring Nola in again"

You can't say 5 free days of boarding/daycare for services not rendered. This is deceptive 🤷‍♂️

Re. Communication,

"boarding happens at the owner's house, where she and her father live."

-- Sorry, but is it wrong to interpret from this that the owner is the primary caretaker, not the father?  😅

Friendly, helpful and patient staff. My puppy Bailey is pretty fearful of other dogs but she loves going to Noelle’s and the work they do on basic training and supporting me to continue that training at home is so helpful - particularly with a high energy Springer. Hopefully we get Bailey to the point she can join them on their beach walks - one of the many reasons I take her to Noelle’s. Highly recommend.
Thank you!
i highly recommend Naoko she did an amazing job with Charlie. Naoko was friendly, loving and patient with Charlie with it being his first time there. We definitely will be back! Thank you.
Sandy was very knowledgeable about puppies and gave us lots of practical tips! The classes were organized and we were able to learn a lot from her

Naoko is an amazing groomer. Been taking my bichon frise there for a while and she grooms him perfectly. Open to requests, able to send her reference photos. My dog has some nervousness around his paws being handled by other groomers but Naoko does an amazing job with him and makes him comfortable and he’s always been in a great mood afterwards.
Thanks Arjun! 🥰 …

Naoko has such a lovely way with my dogs and the cut she gives is consistent and exactly what I want!
I am finally happy to drop my dogs off to be groomed as they are actually excited to see Naoko!❤️
Thank you Naoko!!
Very handsome and happy dog after his groom
Thank you so much!

Noelle’s has been an awesome place for Willa. We transferred to Noelle’s daycare after our previous place shut down and we have been thrilled by how attentive they are to the pups and their wellbeing. When boarding Willa, although we missed her, we knew she was in excellent hands and our anxiety went way down. They also provided regular updates and it was so nice to see her having fun. Highly recommend Noelle’s Pet Love to anyone looking for a safe and dedicated daycare, grooming, and boarding.

EDIT: Must also add that Naoko’s grooming is fantastic! Willa always comes home looking so tidy and clean.
Thank you Emily! Happy New Year!
Price was incredibly expensive and my dogs came back with their paws still messy and hair untrimmed.  i had to go to another groomers a couple weeks later to get them redone.

I take my 9month old energetic Labrador puppy to Noelle’s day care weekly. The staff are all so friendly and skilled! My pup loves going there and I feel at ease that he is well cared for and enjoying the day! Would definitely recommend! I have also taken him to have his nails trimmed by Naoko, who is great!

Noelle's Pet Love was recommended to me by a someone I met at a dog park. I started taking Olive for regular daycare and beach walks since she was 5 months old. She loves going to daycare. She gets to play, gets exercise, gets mental and physical stimulation, and dog training. Olive is well socialized with other dogs and people because of Noelle's Pet Love. Staff is lovely and the hours are very convenient as they offer early drops offs and late pick ups. They even offer boarding  and grooming which I have not yet tried but if I ever need it, it's good to know it is available.

Our 18 month old puppy started daycare and life has never been more fun for him. He looks forward to playing with his friends every week and heads out to the beach where he can explore. As a dog parent, I don’t have to worry about him as …

When we attended our first session at Noelles Puppy Training Classes my 4-month-old, active miniature pinscher, Coco was nervous and a bit frightened of the other dogs and people. By the last session, her behaviour had improved enormously, …
Thank you! 😄 …

We love Noelle’s!! Our boy Fred is always so excited when we pull up, we know he loves it! The fact that they do one on one training and send out videos explaining what to work on at home, really sets them apart from all the other daycares!! We would 10/10 recommend!!
Thank you!

My labradoodle has been coming to Noelle’s Daycare since May and we are so happy with their service!  I changed my dog’s  daycare because she likes being outside and we have the option here to have her go on walks at the beach.  I …

Our 11 month old rescue pup Benny started with Noelle when he was 4 months old.  He loves going to his "club" and the beach walks are a highlight of his day!  Benny has also boarded with Noelle several times including a longstay of 2 weeks …
